source_record.author: PJ Hamel

source_record.ordered_process: Poolish 14 h at room temperature; mix ~4 min; bulk 45 min, fold, 45 min; divide into 3 pieces, bench 15-60 min; shape; proof 45-60 min at ~20 °C (68 °F); bake 450 °F (232.2 °C) 24-28 min on stone with steam.

Normalized measures using KAB weight chart: 3 cups AP flour (360 g), 1 1/3 cups lukewarm water (302.667 g, 84.074 % hydration), 1/4 tsp instant yeast (0.75 g, 0.2083 %), 1 1/4 tsp salt with explicit table-salt assumption (6 g/tsp = 7.5 g, 2.083 %). source_record.role: Primary published recipe; high-hydration pan variant
source_record.original_measures: Dough: 360 g AP flour, 284 g warm water, 9 g table salt, 5 g sugar, 3 g instant yeast, 18 g EVOO. Pan & topping: 26 g EVOO, flaky salt.

source_record.ordered_process: Mix, rest 15 min; 4 bowl-fold sets separated by 15 min rests (45 min folding phase); bulk 1 h at 70-75 °F (21.1-23.9 °C); transfer to oiled 9-in square pan; pan rise 1-1.5 h; dimple and top; bake 475 °F (246.1 °C) 15-18 min; optional 1-2 min broil; finish 5-7 min on rack in switched-off oven. Ingredient note gives desired finished dough 82–86 F; target 29 C is editorial. Pan proof ambient is described qualitatively as warm room temperature.

Original measures: 360 g all-purpose flour, 284 g water (78.889 %), 18 g olive oil in dough (5.0 %), 9 g table salt (2.5 %), 5 g sugar (1.389 %), 3 g instant yeast (0.833 %). Non-dough exclusions: 26 g divided olive oil (pan coating and top drizzle) and flaky sea salt topping are excluded from dough.
